passages.provision_quote: That Section 31 of Article I thereof is repealed.
passages.note: Bill text repeals Prop 209's ban on race/sex preferences but does not itself mandate or strengthen any enforcement clause.
Assembly Floor vote page shows Ramos voting Aye on ACA 5; 14 of 74 cast votes were No, so not near-unanimous.
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 60 Noes Count 14 NVR Count 5

rows.reasoning: Ramos voted Aye on ACA 5, which repeals Section 31 of Article I (Proposition 209's prohibition on race- and sex-based preferences in public employment, education, and contracting). A repeal that permits race-conscious programs to resume shows the pro-side against 'eliminate affirmative action and all race-based government programs,' but it does not itself 'mandate racial equity requirements' or 'strengthen civil rights enforcement'; ruling out rung 5 does not establish any remaining rung's clauses.
